channel.title: The Albert Lea Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Albert Lea Tribune (albertleatribune.com)

item.title: Star Class: Learning with bean bags
item.description: Aleisha Lauer's 3-year-old preschool class played a fun and engaging activity called “Pass the Bean Bag.”

item.title: April Jeppson: It’s time to see a little more sunshine
item.description: Have you ever been out of town, tried a new restaurant and discovered your new favorite dish? Days go by, and you’re still thinking about how delicious it was. You start researching whether restaurants closer to home offer something similar on their menu.

item.title: Senate Report: Transparency, accountability lead to affordability
item.description: Minnesotans are careful with their budgets. They set priorities, plan for the future and live within their means. Unfortunately, Minnesota state government is failing to show the same responsibility.

item.title: Guest column: Get in the Blue Zone: Eat until only 80% full
item.description: In the rush of daily lives, it’s easy to treat a meal like a task to be finished rather than an experience to be savored. Many of us were raised in the “clean your plate” club, but the world’s longest-lived people — those in the Blue Zones — practice a different kind of discipline.

item.title: Sign up now for firearms safety certification
item.description: The fall hunting seasons might seem a long way off, but the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources encourages anyone who plans to take a firearms safety class to sign up now.

item.title: Sports Memories: Dahl named Youth Citizen of the Year
item.description: What happened in area sports 10, 20 and 50 years ago?

item.title: Finstad announces 2026 Congressional Art Competition
item.description: First District Congressman Brad Finstad on Thursday invited high school students from the district to participate in the 2026 Congressional Art Competition.

item.title: Mayo Clinic reports record $1.47B profit in 2025
item.description: Mayo Clinic reported record profits last year driven by strong patient demand for health care services, big investment returns and more philanthropic giving to the Rochester-based health system.

item.title: LIFE Center of Freeborn County a space for adults with developmental disabilities to learn, grow and serve the community
item.description: Spring is just around the corner, and with it comes new opportunities to serve the community. One organization getting ready for an increase in activities is the LIFE Center of Freeborn County.

item.title: 8 students, staff recognized for the Wall of Inspiration
item.description: Eight Albert Lea High School students and staff members on Friday were honored by their peers by receiving a tile on the school’s Wall of Inspiration.
